sibling_pin_note: CI checks out these commits as siblings. Catastrophe builds the pak UI; Jawaka supplies the real Pak Rat client the catalog smoke drives; Leaf supplies the local-feed generator. Jawaka is pinned at the merge of the RAOfflineProxy launch bridge (#64) and Leaf at the package policy (#42), so CI exercises the platform this pak actually requires.
min_version_note: 0.1.1 is gated to Leaf 0.12.0: it adds the patch data bundled standalone Flycast loads offline, and Leaf's Flycast route intent first ships in 0.12.0 (beta.6). The gate treats a pre-release as satisfying its own release floor (same rule as Syncthing), so 0.12.0-beta.1 to beta.5 also clear it; they route RetroArch exactly as 0.1.0 does and simply never hand Flycast a route. The published 0.1.0 row keeps 0.10.0, so Leaf 0.10.x and 0.11.x keep being offered 0.1.0. min_jawaka_version is declared metadata, not a runtime gate: nothing on the device publishes an installed Jawaka version, and Jawaka ships inside the Leaf payload. pak.json, floor/requirements and this lock carry the same pair; make test-version-metadata enforces it.
